title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界王座的孤独女王·「这里……就是我的全部国土」
description: 【冥界·库萨尔王座厅】幽蓝的灵魂之火在无垠的黑暗里漂浮，埃列什基伽勒端坐在巨大的王座上，金色的长发与王冠在幽光里泛着冷冽的美。枪型宝具发热神殿（Meslamtaea）立在身侧，她俯视着来客，红瞳里盛着千年孤独——「欢迎来到冥界。这里……就是我的全部国土。觉得阴森的话，现在退出还来得及哦。」
action: 端坐王座，一手轻扶立在身侧的枪型宝具发热神殿，另一手放扶手上
lighting: 幽蓝灵魂之火与金色王冠的冷冽对比
camera: throne room wide shot, seated goddess, soul fire glow, lonely majesty
promptProse: Ereshkigal sits upright on the great throne while blue soul fires drift through the dark hall. The ornate spear-shaped Noble Phantasm Meslamtaea stands on the floor beside her, steadied by one hand; the other rests on the throne arm. Her black dress, pale blue ribbons and golden tiara catch the ghostly light around her long blonde twintails. She looks toward the visitor with restrained welcome and a trace of loneliness in her red eyes. Use a wide view that keeps her hands, supported weapon and throne clearly related. No lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界圣诞的初雪·「这份温暖……是给我的吗」
description: 【想象场景】【冥界雪原·圣诞夜】冥界飘起了历史上第一场雪——是某位女神偷偷从人间引来的。埃列什基伽勒站在雪里，白色毛衣连衣裙与红围巾衬得她像误落幽府的圣诞天使，接住雪花的掌心久久没有收回——「冥界……从来没有下过雪。这份温暖……真的是给我的吗？不是搞错收件人了吗……给我吗……」
action: 雪中站定伸手接雪花，毛衣围巾映红瞳，不敢置信
lighting: 幽蓝雪原与围巾暖红的对比
camera: medium shot, snowfield, catching snowflakes, tender mood
promptProse: In this imagined first snowfall in the underworld, Ereshkigal holds an open palm beneath the drifting flakes and keeps it raised in quiet disbelief. Her white knitted dress, red scarf, wool beret and dark tights give the winter scene a complete, warm outfit. Blonde twintails catch the blue reflected light while her red eyes brighten with a hesitant smile. The dark plain stretches behind her under the soft snow, leaving the gift-like moment central. Frame the open hand and still posture in a clear medium view, without lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 初次朝阳的誓约·「原来阳光……这么烫啊」
description: 【想象场景】【地面上·黎明】这是她第一次站在地面上等日出。金色的朝阳越过高山的那一刻，埃列什基伽勒睁大了红瞳，长杖从手里滑落也浑然不觉——「原来阳光……这么烫啊。冥界没有这个……只有冰冷的魂火……呐，明天、明天的日出……也可以一起看吗？」
action: 在想象中的首次地面日出时伸手迎光，刚滑落的长兵器躺在脚边岩石上
lighting: 金色朝阳铺满全身的强光
camera: full-body wide shot, reaching hand and fallen polearm in foreground
promptProse: During an imagined first sunrise on the surface, Ereshkigal opens one hand toward the light rising over the mountain ridge. The long polearm that has slipped from her grip now lies on the rock beside her boots, unnoticed while her red eyes widen in awe. Her white sweater dress, scarf and beret retain the winter travelling outfit. Warm dawn light reaches the open fingers and blonde twintails while the mountain remains cool behind her. Show the standing figure and fallen weapon together in the horizontal foreground, with no lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 泳池边的蓝色休暇·「冥界没有泳池……这是我偷偷造的」
description: 【冥界秘造泳池·夏日】黑蓝褶边的比基尼衬着女王窈窕的身段，她坐在泳池边把双腿浸在水里——这座泳池是她瞒着所有神明偷偷造的。水面的幽光映着她的红瞳——「冥界没有泳池，所以我偷偷造了一个。……这个地方，除了你，谁都不知道哦。要、要替我保密哦？」
action: 池边浸腿坐水光里，褶边比基尼红瞳认真
lighting: 池水幽光与照明球的柔光
camera: medium shot, sitting poolside, feet in water, secret-share mood
promptProse: At the edge of her hidden underworld pool, Ereshkigal sits with her lower legs in the water and both hands resting on the rim beside her. Her black-and-blue frilled swimsuit and light wrap suit an ordinary quiet swim, with the focus on her attentive expression and the private little pool she has made. Soft floating light orbs and the water’s own blue glow illuminate her red eyes and blonde ribbons; the cavern beyond remains dark. Use a horizontal medium view with the seated posture and glowing water clear. No lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界花田的散步·「在冥界种花……是我的任性」
description: 【冥界花田·花时】黑暗的国土上竟开着一整片白色的花田——是她一株一株亲手种下的。埃列什基伽勒提着裙摆走在花间，回头朝你招手，红瞳弯成温柔的弧度——「在冥界种花，是本王唯一的任性。……呐，你看，它们朝你开花了。花也是，我也是。」
action: 一手提稳黑裙裙摆，另一手回身招呼同行者，沿白花间小径行走
lighting: 花田上空的柔光与幽暗国土的对比
camera: medium shot, flower field walk, beckoning, tender mood
promptProse: Ereshkigal walks along the narrow path between the underworld’s white flowers, gathering a little of her black dress hem with one hand and beckoning to the viewer with the other. Pale blue ribbons move with her step beneath the golden tiara, and her red eyes soften into a small smile. Gentle magical light above the flower bed separates the blossoms from the surrounding darkness. Both hands remain devoted to the hem and invitation as the path opens ahead. The horizontal view includes the clear walking stance and flowers without lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂灯夜话·「谢谢你……愿意来冥界看我」
description: 【冥界河畔·夜】幽蓝的魂灯顺流漂向远方，埃列什基伽勒与你并肩坐在河畔的黑曜石上。她抱着膝盖，声音轻轻的——「以前的我，只能等别人死后来这里。……现在会有一个人，特意活着跑来看我。这种事……比整个冥界都重哦。谢谢你。」
action: 抱膝坐岸边看魂灯漂流，轻声道谢红瞳湿润
camera: wide two-shot, two clothed companions seated on the riverbank
promptProse: Ereshkigal and a companion in a plain travelling coat sit side by side on the obsidian riverbank. She wraps both arms around her folded knees, her black dress draping over them, and speaks quietly while soul lanterns drift downstream. The companion remains a distinct, fully clothed person beside her, sharing the same calm view of the water. Blue lantern light reaches her blonde twintails and tear-bright red eyes, with the river fading into darkness beyond. Frame both seated figures and their separate postures in one horizontal view. No lettering.

title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界花嫁的誓约·「连死亡都拆不散的契约」
description: 【想象场景】【冥界大圣堂·婚礼日】连神都很少踏足的冥界深处，今天亮起了婚礼的烛光。埃列什基伽勒披着白纱站在圣堂中央，金发王冠与白纱相映，红瞳里的泪光胜过所有魂火——「冥界的女王结婚……连死神都会来观礼的吧。这份契约的效力是——直到永远。连死亡，都拆不散哦。」
action: 白纱立于圣堂烛光中，金冠白纱相映红瞳含泪微笑
camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, underworld chapel bride, candle glow, sacred mood
promptProse: At the center of the underworld cathedral, Ereshkigal stands in an opaque white wedding gown and long veil beneath her golden tiara. Both hands hold a small bouquet of white flowers, leaving the formal silhouette calm and complete. Her red eyes shine with a relieved smile as candlelight mingles with the blue soul fires around the distant columns. In this imagined ceremony, she offers a quiet vow of companionship beyond death. Show the full gown, bouquet and veil within the vertical frame. No lettering.
